notes:
• Leaving the player while a source is stuck or still starting now keeps your spot, so you can resume where you were
• When a video server doesn't answer at all, ValFlix stops trying after about 30 seconds instead of spinning for minutes
• A fresh link after a dropped connection comes from another linked debrid service the file is cached on, when there is one
• If a source you pick won't play and the one before it had stopped too, the Sources list opens again instead of going back to the dead one
• A picked source that hasn't started after 45 seconds is given up on
